text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Active Mobility (Enforcement) Regulations 2018 and come into operation on 1 May 2018.

heading.en: Manner to claim for seized vehicles

text.en:
2.—(1) A person making a claim under section 51(2)(ba) of the Act to a seized vehicle to the Authority must do so either by post to the address as stated at the Authority’s official website at http://www.lta.gov.sg or by e‑mail to feedback@lta.gov.sg.
[S 708/2020 wef 28/08/2020]
(2) A person, when making a claim in accordance with paragraph (1), must provide to the Authority —
(a)all documents that are relied on to prove that he or she owns the seized vehicle; and
(b)such other documents as the Authority may require the person to provide to prove that he or she owns the seized vehicle.
(3) The documents mentioned in paragraph (2) —
(a)may be provided in either physical or electronic form; and
(b)may be either original documents or copies of such original documents.
(4) Where a person making a claim provides copies of original documents, whether in physical or electronic form, the Authority may require the person to produce the original document from which the copy was made.

heading.en: Form of notice to attend court

text.en: 3. A notice to be served on a person under section 54 of the Act is to be in the form set out at the Authority’s official website at http://www.lta.gov.sg.
